creabb/accordion.title: Accordion
creabb/accordion.description: Build vertically collapsing accordions in combination with our Collapse JavaScript plugin.

creabb/accordion-item.title: Accordion Item
creabb/accordion-item.description: A single collapsible section within an accordion.

creabb/alert.title: Alert
creabb/alert.description: Provide contextual feedback messages for typical user actions with the handful of available and flexible alert messages.

creabb/banner.title: Banner
creabb/banner.description: A banner area holding one or more banner items.

creabb/banner-item.title: Banner Item
creabb/banner-item.description: A single banner within a banner area.

creabb/breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
creabb/breadcrumb.description: Indicate the current page's location within a navigational hierarchy that automatically adds separators via CSS.

creabb/button.title: Button
creabb/button.description: Custom button styles for actions in forms, dialogs, and more, with support for multiple sizes and states.

creabb/button-group.title: Button Group
creabb/button-group.description: Group a series of buttons together on a single line or stack them in a vertical column.

creabb/card.title: Card
creabb/card.description: A flexible and extensible content container with multiple variants and options.

creabb/card-body.title: Card Body
creabb/card-body.description: The building block of a card. Use it whenever you need a padded section within a card.

creabb/card-footer.title: Card Footer
creabb/card-footer.description: Add an optional footer within a card.

creabb/card-group.title: Card Group
creabb/card-group.description: Render cards as a single, attached element with equal width and height columns. Card groups start off stacked and become attached at the small breakpoint.

creabb/card-header.title: Card Header
creabb/card-header.description: Add an optional header within a card.

creabb/carousel.title: Carousel
creabb/carousel.description: A slideshow component for cycling through elements — images or slides of text — like a carousel.

creabb/carousel-item.title: Carousel Item
creabb/carousel-item.description: A single slide within a carousel.

creabb/collapse.title: Collapse
creabb/collapse.description: Toggle the visibility of content across your project with a few classes and our JavaScript plugins.

creabb/column.title: Column
creabb/column.description: Modify columns with a handful of options for alignment, ordering, and offsetting thanks to the flexbox grid system.

creabb/column-break.title: Column Break
creabb/column-break.description: Breaking columns to a new line in flexbox requires a small hack: add an element with width: 100% wherever you want to wrap your columns to a new line. Normally this is accomplished with multiple .rows, but not every implementation method can account for this.

creabb/container.title: Container
creabb/container.description: Containers are a fundamental building block of Bootstrap that contain, pad, and align your content within a given device or viewport.

creabb/content-grid.title: Content Grid
creabb/content-grid.description: A grid of content items with an optional heading and intro.

creabb/content-grid-item.title: Content Grid Item
creabb/content-grid-item.description: A single item within a content grid.

creabb/content-with-media.title: Content with Media
creabb/content-with-media.description: A content section with an image or video beside it.

creabb/div.title: Div
creabb/div.description: Creates a div element with the ability to add whatever classes you want. Useful for custom layouts built from Bootstrap utility and helper classes.

creabb/dropdown-item.title: Dropdown Item
creabb/dropdown-item.description: A single entry within a dropdown menu.

creabb/icon.title: Icon
creabb/icon.description: Display a Bootstrap icon in any of the available theme colours and sizes.

creabb/list-group.title: List Group
creabb/list-group.description: List groups are a flexible and powerful component for displaying a series of content.

creabb/list-group-item.title: List Group Item
creabb/list-group-item.description: A single item within a list group.

creabb/media-grid.title: Media Grid
creabb/media-grid.description: Display multiple media items in a rich gallery.

creabb/media-grid-image.title: Image
creabb/media-grid-image.description: Insert an image to make a visual statement.

creabb/modal.title: Modal
creabb/modal.description: Use Bootstrap’s JavaScript modal plugin to add dialogs to your site for lightboxes, user notifications, or completely custom content.

creabb/modal-body.title: Modal Body
creabb/modal-body.description: The body of a modal dialog.

creabb/modal-footer.title: Modal Footer
creabb/modal-footer.description: The footer of a modal dialog.

creabb/modal-header.title: Modal Header
creabb/modal-header.description: The header of a modal dialog.

creabb/nav-and-tab.title: Nav and Tab
creabb/nav-and-tab.description: Navigation available in Bootstrap share general markup and styles, from the base .nav class to the active and disabled states.

creabb/nav-and-tab-item.title: Nav and Tab Item
creabb/nav-and-tab-item.description: A single link within a nav or tab list.

creabb/offcanvas.title: Offcanvas
creabb/offcanvas.description: Build hidden sidebars into your project for navigation, shopping carts, and more.

creabb/offcanvas-body.title: Offcanvas Body
creabb/offcanvas-body.description: The body of an offcanvas panel.

creabb/offcanvas-header.title: Offcanvas Header
creabb/offcanvas-header.description: The header of an offcanvas panel.

creabb/post-grid.title: Post Grid
creabb/post-grid.description: A grid of posts or pages, queried automatically, with an optional heading, intro and pagination.

creabb/progress.title: Progress
creabb/progress.description: Document the progress of a task or an action with a progress bar.

creabb/row.title: Row
creabb/row.description: Rows are wrappers for columns. Each column has horizontal padding (called a gutter) for controlling the space between them. This padding is then counteracted on the rows.

creabb/spinner.title: Spinner
creabb/spinner.description: Indicate the loading state of a component or page with Bootstrap spinners, built entirely with HTML, CSS, and no JavaScript.

creabb/strip.title: Strip
creabb/strip.description: Full width strip allowing background colors, images and videos.

creabb/tabs.title: Tabs
creabb/tabs.description: Wrap navigation and its tab panes so they can be shown and hidden together.

creabb/toast.title: Toast
creabb/toast.description: Push notifications to your visitors with a toast, a lightweight and easily customizable alert message.

creabb/toast-body.title: Toast Body
creabb/toast-body.description: The body of a toast notification.

creabb/toast-header.title: Toast Header
creabb/toast-header.description: The header of a toast notification.
